title: Rebuild session state from git, not the handover
what: rebuild session state from git (branches, worktrees, merges, marks), the queue, the ledger and reports; keep by hand only the owner's words and decisions; at session start name each difference between the handover and the facts (owner, q4 "a"; v3 #4)

Also: the owner's decisions and instructions are kept verbatim in a dated structured log (a JSON file the library appends to), and the state of a session is rebuilt from git plus that log; the handover text is only a readable rendering of it (owner, 22 Oct: 'persist structured, operate with scripts').
why: the owner ranked it 80 in the work order of 22 Oct.
